name: Varek
summary: Varek pairs a matte silver grey travertine top with a calm, stone born sophistication that feels naturally elevated. The legs are wrapped in dark gray elm veneer, adding a refined wood texture that grounds the piece with modern warmth. The contrast of cool stone and rich veneer gives it a composed, high tier presence. Top in Silver-grey travertine in matte finish, Legs with dark grey elm veneer. 45x40x50
